_doc: What each tested change is, for docs/model/feature-tests.md (python -m rentfrontier.ledger). Keys are feature sets, or '+term' for a model term. kind 'location' marks features read from where a building is; their nulls are retested first when a neighbourhood is added (Ben, 2026-10-06). An optional 'verdict' replaces the computed one, for a change blocked or failed on other grounds. 'hand_tests' lists pairs the ledger can't find itself: data rules, and pairs on a subset of rows.

nb-bedtext-v1.about: ad states fewer or more bedrooms than the record

nb-relist-v1.about: months since the apartment's previous listing

nb-coded-v1.about: listing record's outdoor space types and extra rooms

nb-prevprice-v1.about: how the unit's previous listing was repriced
nb-prevprice-v1.verdict: blocked: no time dependence, semantically invalid (#403)

nb3-prevprice-v2.about: how the unit's previous listing was repriced (nb3 base)
nb3-prevprice-v2.verdict: blocked: no time dependence, semantically invalid (#403)

nb3-loc-v1.about: smooth location surface: Gaussian bumps 250 m apart, so neighbouring buildings share a premium
nb3-loc-v1.verdict: no clear gain; provisional: the coded-v2 reference failed its group R-hat gate (110 W 26th St under unit-splits-v3) and loc-v1 had min ESS 361; clean pair on unit-splits-v4 due 2026-10-08

nb3-text-v1.about: ad names a physical attribute beyond the coded flags: whole house, penthouse, garden level, terrace, loft and others
nb3-text-v1.verdict: fair WV+GV score +43.7 ± 23.5 (1.9 SE); not served, back in the research backlog as text-v2 (Ben, 2026-10-07)

nb3-attrs-v1.about: ad states one of 15 attributes: walk-in closet, live-in super, utilities included, pre-war and others

nb3-lineface-v1.about: orientation read from the apartment's line

nb3-garden-v1.about: rear windows over the open block or a wall

nb3-through-v1.about: floor-through: apartments per floor, ad says floor-through

nb3-quiet-v1.about: quiet street: busy road, narrow roadway, mid-block

nb3-loud-v1.about: a building side fronting a busy street

nb3-nearby-v1.about: walk to dog run, hospital, EMS, drop-in center, NYCHA, MSG

nb3-retail-v1.about: storefronts and food places within 150 m

nb3-lines-v1.about: each subway line group within an 8-minute walk

nb3-access-v1.about: jobs within 30 minutes by walking and subway (LODES)

nb3-bedsize-v1.about: bed size from the ad text

nb3-loft-v1.about: loft building (MapPLUTO D5, or half of >= 3 earlier ads say loft), with its own bedroom and size gradients
nb3-loft-v1.verdict: skipped by Ben 2026-10-07 17:46Z before its exploration pair; not tested

+dayfourier.about: Fourier season at each listing's date

+bednoise.about: a residual scale by bedroom group

+yearnoise.about: a residual scale by bedroom group and year

hand_tests.about: a unit's history splits where an ad's bedroom count differs by 2 or more from the previous ad's
number-word-and-letter unit labels (fourb, five-a) joined to their twins when bedrooms agree
the text-v1 phrases scored on the West Village and Greenwich Village rows only
hand_tests.verdict: no clear gain on the fair rows (1.9 SE); back in the research backlog as text-v2

hand_tests.about: spelled-out unit labels joined to their short spellings (126 groups, 262 rows), paired with fa61d6c's coded-v2 arm on v9 + splits-v4
hand_tests.verdict: gain at 2.2 SE in exploration; Modeling queued the Modal full fit after the v4 serving refit

hand_tests.about: flag: the ad says newly or gut renovated and the unit's previous ad (with text) did not; the leak-free form of a renovation split
hand_tests.verdict: no gain; coefficient near zero; PR closed

hand_tests.about: rent-stabilized units of the building's lot from the DOF tax bill of the year before the listing (taxbills.nyc 2007–2017, JustFix 2018–2024)
hand_tests.verdict: null on all 121,911 rows (gate passed, R-hat 1.0037, ESS 767, 1,141 s on Modal); PR closed

hand_tests.about: first review of Greenwich Village, Gramercy Park and Flatiron: 45 rows (other address, short stays, shops and offices)
hand_tests.verdict: fit held, not counted: 9 of its 45 rows were found only by screens on the row's own rent (rent against the building-bedroom median); replaced by quarantine-v9, which keeps the 31 the generic rent-blind checks catch and a blind reading confirms

hand_tests.about: second review of the three: 51 rows picked from ads the served model fit badly (rent ratio, Pareto k, PIT), confirmed from the ad text
hand_tests.verdict: fit held, not counted: candidates chosen by each row's own residual, which favours rows the model fits badly and lifts PSIS-LOO by construction; replaced by quarantine-v9, which keeps the 14 the generic rent-blind checks catch and a blind reading confirms

hand_tests.about: v6 plus 95 rows, in place of v7 and v8: generic text checks (a far neighbourhood from NYC's NTA list or a street above 40th, shop or office, shared bath or room share, several apartments in one ask, short stay), run over every ad of the three regardless of rent; each hit read with no rent shown
hand_tests.verdict: queued as one Modal full fit via Modeling (current rules with quarantine-v6 swapped for v9)

hand_tests.about: only rows a rent-blind review finds, in place of v1 to v9: v9's text checks also run over every Chelsea and West Village ad (v1 to v6 there were picked partly by rent), each hit read with no rent shown; 124 Chelsea/WV rows (91 already in v6) plus v9's 95, 219 in all; 191 v6 rows come back
hand_tests.verdict: queued as one Modal full fit via Modeling (current rules with quarantine-v6 swapped for v10)

hand_tests.about: every MapPLUTO field of the building as the release of the year before the listing had it (2009 on)
hand_tests.verdict: clear loss on all 121,911 rows (gate passed, R-hat 1.0043, ESS 805, 1,014 s on Modal); the dated size fields differ on 8-10% of rows but almost never because the building changed (1-3% new or altered since), so they are mostly older revised estimates; superseded by nb5-plutoasof-v2

hand_tests.about: only the lot's alteration years as the release of the year before the listing had them (none from a release older than the building); size and class stay today's; altered since 2000 changes on 3,137 rows
hand_tests.verdict: not fitted: dropped from Modeling's queue for nb5-plutoasof-v3

hand_tests.about: every MapPLUTO field of the building (year built, address and position stay today's) as the latest of the 44 archived releases (09v1-26v2) published at least a week before the listing had it, by each release's publication date (its archive server date, else the end of the month after its own documents' month; an undated release, 22v2, is never read); codes in today's spelling; lot fields change on 35,586 of 135,540 rows (20,422 against v1's release choice), features beyond the centring shift on 27,564
hand_tests.verdict: one Modal full fit via Modeling; Ben, 2026-10-08: "Serve plutoasof-v3 on passing the gate, as the new base."

hand_tests.about: v10 plus 50 rows from neighbourhoods v10 never read: v10's text checks over every East Village, NoMad and Stuyvesant Town/PCV ad, each place measured from that neighbourhood's own centre, every one of the 510 hits read with no rent shown; 39 East Village rows (shops and offices, ads for apartments elsewhere, dorm rooms with a shared bath, short sublets), 10 NoMad and one Stuyvesant Town ad for Harlem; v11's 13 rows not included
hand_tests.verdict: built, not fitted: model runs are paused

hand_tests.about: every row priced at its listing's last on-market ask in place of its first (Ben, 2026-10-14); a change on or after the off-market day is skipped as a placeholder when more than twice or under half the ask before it, or a raise of over 20% to exactly $10,000; a same-day fix on the first day counts; an ask more than twice or under half the first, or a page price 9 to 11 times off, takes whichever is nearer the building's same-bedroom median; 79,791 of 215,156 rows change, median 4.9%, 30 by more than 2x; supersedes tune-latestask-v1 (#706) and tune-finalask-v1 (#700/#704)
hand_tests.verdict: built, not fitted: C refits under it with quarantine-v13 (Modeling)

hand_tests.about: v12 plus 2 rows from a price screen on latest asks: a row more than 3 times off both its unit's and its building's leave-one-out same-bedroom median; all 11 hits over 2.5 read with their ads; a studio whose ad offers a 3-bedroom, and a teaser ad for a building's 2-bedrooms in general
hand_tests.verdict: built, not fitted: C refits under it with latest-ask-v2 (Modeling)

hand_tests.about: v13 plus 13 rows from #542's rent-blind text screen with more words for shops and restaurants (retail, frontage, certificate of occupancy, kitchen exhaust, event space) over the five neighbourhoods before East Village, NoMad and Stuyvesant Town; every one of 693 new hits read with no rent shown; storefronts and a cafe near Bleecker, an event studio, two 5-month leases, one Battery Park ad; 10 of the 13 are v6 rows
hand_tests.verdict: built, not fitted: 13 rows is under the 0.25% negligible share, so a C refit on quarantine-v13 stays servable (no refit for this rule)

hand_tests.about: v15 plus #420's spelled-out label joins (3rd-fl and 3, penthouse-a and pha, garden and g, 4-rear and 4r, third and 3) where both units' median bedrooms agree, the label rules' guard since v3; on the current rules 176 of the 505 rows the unguarded join would move change unit, 0.082% of 214,872; the latest-ask price screen gives the same 11 hits and the same 2 over 3x
hand_tests.verdict: built, not fitted: under the 0.25% negligible share, so a C refit on unit-labels-v15 stays servable (no refit for this rule)
